newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent trades higher, tracking NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent trades higher, tracking NYMEX.

text.p: SIMEX October Brent futures were traded higher on Friday in late Asian trading compared with London's close a day-earlier.
October Brent last traded at $20.86 per barrel, up 11 cents from London. Volume was a modest 64 lots.
Brokers said a firm tone on NYMEX supported by this week's inventory draws on U.S. heating oil and gasoline was underpinning the market.
The October NYMEX contract was last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $22.31 per barrel, up from $22.15 in New York.
Brokers said Brent would look to target $20.98, last week's high and the highest front-month price since April.
But some cautioned that NYMEX might look to square up later ahead of the long U.S. weekend. U.S. markets are closed on Monday for a national holiday.
The NYMEX pit will be closed on Monday for a U.S. national holiday, while ACCESS will not open until 2300 GMT on Monday.
